pages.title: Planet Information
pages.text: While wearing a DeepSpace Helmet, looking at a planet displays its information. Press J by default to toggle the display. Its armor stats match an iron helmet. Craft one iron helmet and one Heart of the Sea shapelessly to obtain one DeepSpace Helmet.

pages.title: Other Helmets
pages.text: Craft it shapelessly with an item in the helmet tag to add the DeepSpace information display to that helmet.
